say:1:1030503001:0.text: That's right! Our village is safe now, all thanks to Lord Hogan and you!
say:1:1030503001:0.source_cn: 可不是嘛，托你和霍根老爷的福，咱村得救了！
say:1:1030503001:0.male: That's right! Our village is safe now, all thanks to Lord Hogan and you!
say:1:1030503001:0.female: That's right! Our village is safe now, all thanks to Lord Hogan and you!

say:2:1030503002:0.text: I didn't expect to see grapes here. If I had known they were grown so close to the village, we wouldn't have felt so envious of those Southville snobs...
say:2:1030503002:0.source_cn: 没想到这里也有葡萄，早知道就在离村这么近的地方，咱几个...
